scenario: Create a master trader account Pre: User is registered and passed basic onboarding.
steps: Steps:1. Navigate to Master Trader registration.2. Submit nickname, trading bio, strategy tags, and fee structure (e.g. 20% perf fee).3. Bind broker account credentials. Expected:Master account record created in DB, public profile generated, status set to Active, broker connection verified.

scenario: Create a follower account Pre: User registered and KYC verified.
steps: Steps:1. Navigate to Follower portal.2. Create follower trading account.3. Deposit funds or bind funded broker account. Expected:Follower profile initialized with available margin balance, risk settings defaulted, ready to subscribe.

scenario: Link follower to master Pre: Master account is active; follower account has sufficient free equity.
steps: Steps:1. Follower selects master profile.2. Click 'Copy Trader' / 'Link Account'.3. Confirm linking terms. Expected:Linkage established in relational DB; master follower-count increments by 1; link status set to Pending_Activation.

scenario: Subscribe follower to master strategy Pre: Follower linked to master; allocation mode configured (e.g., multiplier = 1.0).
steps: Steps:1. Set allocation funds ($1,000) and risk parameters.2. Click 'Start Copying'.3. Engine registers subscription event. Expected:Subscription state transitions to 'Active'; follower added to master's fan-out Redis pub/sub routing channel.

scenario: Unsubscribe follower from master Pre: Follower currently actively copying master.
steps: Steps:1. Follower navigates to subscription settings.2. Click 'Stop Copying'.3. Select policy for open positions (keep open vs market close). Expected:Subscription state updated to 'Unsubscribed'; follower removed from execution fan-out; no further master trades copied.

scenario: Master places BUY market order Pre: Master and 1+ active followers; market open.
steps: Steps:1. Master sends BUY 1.0 lot EURUSD Market Order.2. Master broker confirms fill.3. Engine receives execution webhook/socket. Expected:Engine calculates follower lot based on sizing model and places BUY EURUSD market order for each active follower; all fill within slippage tolerance.

scenario: Master places SELL market order Pre: Master and followers active; market open.
steps: Steps:1. Master sends SELL 0.5 lot GBPUSD Market Order.2. Master fill confirmed. Expected:Followers receive SELL order with respective calculated lot size; position opened in follower portfolio; order mapped to master order ID.

scenario: Master places limit order Pre: Strategy allows pending order copying.
steps: Steps:1. Master places BUY LIMIT 1.0 lot USDJPY at 150.00.2. Pending order registered on master exchange. Expected:Follower pending order placed simultaneously or mirrored upon master fill depending on configured pending-order policy.

scenario: Master places stop order Pre: Pending order copying enabled.
steps: Steps:1. Master places BUY STOP 1.0 lot XAUUSD at 2700.00. Expected:Follower stop order created according to copy policy; trigger prices accurately mapped.

scenario: Master modifies pending-order price Pre: Master and follower both hold unfilled pending order.
steps: Steps:1. Master changes BUY LIMIT from 150.00 to 150.50. Expected:Follower pending order modified to 150.50 without recreating order ticket or losing order queue priority unnecessarily.

scenario: Master cancels pending order Pre: Unfilled pending order exists on master and follower.
steps: Steps:1. Master cancels pending BUY LIMIT order. Expected:Corresponding follower pending order is cancelled immediately; status updated to Cancelled; reserved margin released.

scenario: Master closes position Pre: Open copied position exists on master and follower.
steps: Steps:1. Master closes 1.0 lot EURUSD position at market. Expected:Follower position is closed at market immediately; realized P&L recorded; position status updated to Closed.

scenario: Master partially closes position Pre: Master opened 2.0 lots; follower opened 1.0 lot (0.5x ratio).
steps: Steps:1. Master closes 1.0 lot (50% partial close). Expected:Follower closes exactly 50% of copied position (0.5 lot); remaining 0.5 lot stays open with adjusted ticket/position ID.

scenario: Master modifies stop-loss (SL) Pre: Active position open with existing or no SL.
steps: Steps:1. Master sets or modifies SL price on EURUSD. Expected:Follower position SL modified to match master SL (or adjusted proportionally if price offsets apply); broker acknowledgement verified.

scenario: Master modifies take-profit (TP) Pre: Active position open.
steps: Steps:1. Master updates TP price on open position. Expected:Follower TP order updated to match master target; position record shows updated TP.

scenario: Master uses trailing stop-loss Pre: Trailing SL supported by copy engine / broker.
steps: Steps:1. Master enables 20-pip trailing stop.2. Market moves in favorable direction by 30 pips. Expected:Follower trailing stop ratchets upwards maintaining exact pip distance as configured in copy parameters.

scenario: Master opens multiple positions Pre: Master has multiple trades across different pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY).
steps: Steps:1. Master opens 3 distinct market positions in sequence. Expected:Follower copies each position independently; correct ticket IDs assigned; margin allocated for all 3 positions.

scenario: Follower has insufficient margin Pre: Follower free margin is below required margin for calculated lot size.
steps: Steps:1. Master opens 5.0 lots.2. Engine calculates follower requires 1.0 lot ($1,000 margin), but follower only has $200 free margin. Expected:Follower order rejected or auto-downsized to maximum allowable lot (depending on config); master and other followers execute unaffected; error logged.

scenario: Master order rejected by broker Pre: Master order fails broker pre-trade validation (e.g., price off-market).
steps: Steps:1. Master submits order; broker returns REJECTED. Expected:No trade signals dispatched to followers; follower accounts remain completely untouched.

scenario: Follower order rejected by broker Pre: Follower broker account temporarily rejects order (e.g. lot step violation).
steps: Steps:1. Master fills order.2. Follower order fails at follower's broker. Expected:Rejection captured in follower audit log; notification dispatched; master and other followers remain unaffected.

scenario: Master account disconnects during trading Pre: Master broker API connection drops.
steps: Steps:1. Disconnect master socket.2. Trigger reconnection logic. Expected:System detects disconnect within heartbeat timeout; flags master status; upon reconnect, syncs position state with broker ledger without duplicating orders.

scenario: Follower account disconnects during trading Pre: Follower API token expires or socket disconnects.
steps: Steps:1. Follower disconnects while master trades.2. Follower reconnects. Expected:Engine queues missed close events or evaluates sync policy upon reconnect; reconciliation prevents orphan positions.

scenario: Refresh copy trading page UI Pre: Active trades running; UI open.
steps: Steps:1. Hard refresh browser page / app screen during rapid trading. Expected:UI re-hydrates state accurately from backend; active subscriptions, open positions, unrealized P&L remain consistent with server.

scenario: Master trades different symbols with mapping rules Pre: Master trades 'GOLD' on Broker A, follower uses 'XAUUSD' on Broker B.
steps: Steps:1. Master opens trade on GOLD. Expected:Symbol mapper translates GOLD -> XAUUSD; follower order routes correctly to XAUUSD with proper contract specifications.

scenario: Follower manually closes copied trade Pre: Follower has active copied position.
steps: Steps:1. Follower logs into trading terminal and manually closes position. Expected:Engine detects manual closure; unlinks trade ticket; when master later closes trade, follower engine skips closed position without throwing errors.

scenario: Master trades when follower is paused Pre: Follower status is 'Paused'.
steps: Steps:1. Master executes BUY EURUSD. Expected:Engine filters out paused follower; zero orders routed to follower; audit log records 'Skipped: Subscription Paused'.

scenario: Resume copying Pre: Follower resumes subscription from 'Paused' state.
steps: Steps:1. Follower clicks 'Resume Copying'.2. Master submits new order. Expected:Subscription marked Active; new master orders copied; existing historical master orders are NOT backfilled unless 'Copy Existing Positions' was selected.

scenario: Master and follower have different leverage Pre: Master account leverage is 1:100; follower leverage is 1:30.
steps: Steps:1. Master opens 1.0 lot EURUSD.2. Sizing model computes follower position. Expected:Follower margin requirement computed strictly based on follower's 1:30 leverage; order sized down or verified before routing.

scenario: Master and follower use different brokers Pre: Master on Broker X; Follower on Broker Y.
steps: Steps:1. Master places trade. Expected:Order payload dispatched to Broker Y API with Broker Y account credentials, symbols, and formatting.

scenario: Verify copy trading history Pre: Multiple master trades opened and closed over time.
steps: Steps:1. Navigate to Follower History tab.2. Compare with Master Trade History. Expected:Each closed follower trade references corresponding Master Order ID, open/close timestamps, slippage, and net P&L.

scenario: Fixed lot copying Pre: Follower configures Copy Mode = 'Fixed Lot', Value = 0.10 lot.
steps: Steps:1. Master opens 1.0 lot EURUSD.2. Master opens 5.0 lot GBPUSD. Expected:Follower executes exactly 0.10 lot for EURUSD and 0.10 lot for GBPUSD regardless of master lot size.

scenario: Lot multiplier copying Pre: Follower configures Multiplier = 0.5x.
steps: Steps:1. Master opens 2.0 lots.2. Sizing engine executes formula: Follower_Lot = Master_Lot * Multiplier. Expected:Follower executes 1.0 lot (2.0 * 0.5); order respects broker lot steps.

scenario: Equity proportional copying Pre: Master Equity = $10,000; Follower Equity = $2,500 (Ratio = 0.25).
steps: Steps:1. Master opens 2.0 lots.2. Engine computes Follower_Lot = Master_Lot * (Follower_Equity / Master_Equity). Expected:Follower executes 0.50 lot (2.0 * 0.25); rounded to broker minimum lot precision.

scenario: Balance proportional copying Pre: Master Balance = $20,000; Follower Balance = $10,000 (Ratio = 0.50).
steps: Steps:1. Master opens 1.0 lot.2. Engine calculates based on cash balance ratio. Expected:Follower executes 0.50 lot; unencumbered by floating unrealized P&L fluctuations.

scenario: Set minimum lot threshold Pre: Follower configures Min Lot = 0.05 lot (Broker minimum = 0.01).
steps: Steps:1. Master trades 0.02 lot with 0.5x multiplier (computed = 0.01 lot). Expected:Engine bumps follower order to configured minimum lot of 0.05 lot (or rejects if strict floor policy is set).

scenario: Set maximum lot threshold Pre: Follower configures Max Lot = 2.0 lots.
steps: Steps:1. Master places 10.0 lot trade with 0.5x multiplier (computed = 5.0 lots). Expected:Follower order is capped at 2.0 lots; notification/warning logged that position size was constrained by Max Lot rule.

scenario: Set zero lot multiplier Pre: Follower edits settings and inputs 0 as multiplier.
steps: Steps:1. Submit multiplier = 0 in subscription settings. Expected:Validation error displayed 'Multiplier must be greater than 0' or account enters Observation/Paper-copy mode without live executions.

scenario: Set negative multiplier Pre: Follower enters negative multiplier (-1.0).
steps: Steps:1. Attempt to save negative value in copy settings. Expected:Form validation blocks submission with error: 'Multiplier must be positive' (unless Reverse-Copying is an explicitly supported feature).

scenario: Set maximum daily loss limit Pre: Follower sets Max Daily Loss = $500.
steps: Steps:1. Follower suffers cumulative closed loss of $510 within the trading day.2. Master opens new trade. Expected:Risk engine halts copying for follower for remainder of trading day; master order not copied; follower receives risk breach notification.

scenario: Set maximum drawdown limit Pre: Follower configures Max Drawdown = 15%.
steps: Steps:1. Unrealized loss on open positions causes follower equity to drop 15.2% from peak. Expected:Engine triggers risk circuit breaker: auto-closes open copied positions (if configured) and pauses subscription.

scenario: Set maximum open positions limit Pre: Follower configures Max Open Positions = 3.
steps: Steps:1. Follower currently holds 3 copied open trades.2. Master opens a 4th trade. Expected:Engine skips 4th trade for this follower; logs reason 'Max Open Positions Reached (3/3)'; master and other followers unaffected.

scenario: Exclude a symbol Pre: Follower adds 'BTCUSD' and 'XAUUSD' to Symbol Blacklist.
steps: Steps:1. Master executes BUY BTCUSD.2. Master executes BUY EURUSD. Expected:BTCUSD trade is filtered and ignored; EURUSD trade is successfully copied.

scenario: Configure BUY-only or SELL-only copying Pre: Follower configures Directional Filter = 'BUY Only'.
steps: Steps:1. Master executes SELL USDCHF.2. Master executes BUY EURUSD. Expected:SELL trade skipped; BUY trade copied.

scenario: Change copy ratio during active trade Pre: Follower holds 1.0 lot copied at 1.0x ratio.
steps: Steps:1. Follower changes multiplier to 0.5x while trade is running.2. Master closes the trade. Expected:Existing trade closes full 1.0 lot; new subsequent trades adopt the new 0.5x multiplier; no orphaned fractional lots.

scenario: Disable copying with open positions Pre: Follower has 2 open copied positions.
steps: Steps:1. Follower toggles 'Stop Copying'.2. Dialog prompts: 'Close Open Positions' or 'Leave Positions Open'.3. Follower selects 'Close Open Positions'. Expected:Both positions immediately close at market; subscription disabled; ledger confirms clean zero-exposure status.

scenario: Follower equity becomes insufficient Pre: Follower equity drops near margin call level.
steps: Steps:1. Master sends new order. Expected:Pre-trade risk validator checks Free Margin; detects insufficient margin; aborts follower order before routing to broker; logs warning.

scenario: Configure slippage limit Pre: Follower configures Max Slippage = 3 pips.
steps: Steps:1. Master executes EURUSD at 1.0800.2. When follower order arrives at broker, ask price is 1.0805 (5 pips slippage). Expected:Order rejected by slippage check or limit price enforcement; position not opened; notification sent to follower.

scenario: Master and follower have different contract sizes Pre: Master broker standard lot = 100,000 units; Follower broker cent lot = 1,000 units (Factor = 100x).
steps: Steps:1. Master opens 1.0 lot (100,000 units).2. Follower is set to 1.0x exposure copy. Expected:Engine normalizes contract size: follower places 100 cent lots (100,000 units); financial exposure matches 1:1.

scenario: Master places two BUY orders simultaneously Pre: Master triggers 2 concurrent API BUY requests within 5ms.
steps: Steps:1. Fire 2 BUY orders concurrently.2. Ingestion pipeline parses messages. Expected:Each master order is assigned a unique UUID and copied exactly once per follower; no duplicates or skipped orders.

scenario: Master places BUY and SELL simultaneously Pre: Master account in hedging mode fires BUY 1 lot and SELL 1 lot at same instant.
steps: Steps:1. Dispatch simultaneous BUY and SELL.2. Fan out to followers. Expected:Hedging follower accounts open both positions; netting follower accounts resolve net zero or handle per account mode safely.

scenario: Master places 10 orders within 1 second Pre: Master runs EA / algorithmic burst sending 10 market orders in 1 second.
steps: Steps:1. Algorithmic burst fired.2. Ingestion queue handles burst. Expected:Queue buffers and sequences all 10 orders; followers receive all 10 executions in deterministic order without dropped signals.

scenario: Master places order and immediately cancels it Pre: Master submits limit order and issues cancel 20ms later.
steps: Steps:1. Master sends Limit Order.2. Master sends Cancel immediately.3. Orders race through message queue. Expected:If follower pending order is created, cancel must immediately follow and cancel it; no persistent orphan pending orders.

scenario: Master opens and immediately closes position Pre: Master scalp lasts < 150ms.
steps: Steps:1. Master opens position.2. Close signal dispatched before follower open fill acknowledgement arrives. Expected:Engine serializes execution: follower open completes, immediately followed by close order; follower ends with flat position.

scenario: Master modifies SL while follower order is being filled Pre: Master SL update arrives while follower broker is processing fill.
steps: Steps:1. Follower order status is 'PENDING_FILL'.2. Master SL update arrives. Expected:SL update is queued; as soon as follower fill is confirmed, latest valid SL is applied to the newly created position.

scenario: Master modifies TP while follower order is pending Pre: Follower pending limit order awaiting execution.
steps: Steps:1. Master updates TP on pending order. Expected:Follower pending order TP parameter updated smoothly without duplicate ticket creation.

scenario: Master modifies SL twice rapidly Pre: Master adjusts SL to 1.0820, then 50ms later to 1.0810.
steps: Steps:1. Two rapid SL update events generated. Expected:Event stream preserves timestamp/version order; final follower SL state reflects the second update (1.0810).

scenario: Master partially closes while follower order is pending Pre: Master opens 2 lots, then immediately closes 1 lot while follower initial order is in-flight.
steps: Steps:1. Master partial close signal races initial fill signal. Expected:System awaits initial fill confirmation, then applies partial close proportionally; no over-close or orphan residual.

scenario: Master closes position while follower execution is delayed Pre: Follower broker latency is 2000ms; master closes trade in 500ms.
steps: Steps:1. Master open -> Master close.2. Follower open is still pending at slow broker. Expected:When slow broker confirms fill, close order is immediately dispatched to liquidate follower position; final state flat.

scenario: Master sends multiple orders for same symbol Pre: Master enters 3 separate BUY trades on EURUSD at 1-second intervals.
steps: Steps:1. Master opens Trade 1, 2, and 3. Expected:Follower opens 3 corresponding positions; tickets are correctly correlated to respective master ticket IDs.

scenario: Duplicate master trade event delivered Pre: Network glitch causes master broker webhook to deliver identical event twice.
steps: Steps:1. Deliver Order #12345.2. Deliver Order #12345 with identical payload 10ms later. Expected:Idempotency layer detects duplicate Master Event ID; second event discarded; follower executes order once.

scenario: Follower subscribes while master places BUY Pre: Follower 'Subscribe' API call arrives at the same millisecond as Master BUY.
steps: Steps:1. Process concurrent subscribe and trade events. Expected:Deterministic cutoff: If subscription state committed before trade ingestion, trade copies; if after, trade is skipped; zero half-open states.

scenario: Follower unsubscribes while master places BUY Pre: Unsubscribe request arrives concurrently with Master BUY.
steps: Steps:1. Follower clicks Stop Copying.2. Master fires BUY. Expected:Unsubscribe locks follower state; if unsubscribe accepted, new trade is rejected/skipped for this follower.

scenario: Follower pauses while master places order Pre: Follower pauses subscription concurrent with master order placement.
steps: Steps:1. Pause command dispatched.2. Master trade dispatched. Expected:Pause lock takes precedence; order not copied if pause timestamp <= order timestamp.

scenario: Follower resumes while master places order Pre: Follower resumes copying exactly when master executes trade.
steps: Steps:1. Resume request processed concurrently with trade signal. Expected:Trade copied only if subscription is fully active at signal generation time; no partial/unauthorized backfills.

scenario: Follower rapidly pauses and resumes Pre: Follower clicks Pause/Resume 5 times in 2 seconds.
steps: Steps:1. Fire rapid state toggle requests. Expected:State transitions serialized using optimistic locking / state machine; final state matches last click; queue intact.

scenario: Follower unsubscribes while copied position is open Pre: Follower has active open position; clicks unsubscribe.
steps: Steps:1. Follower un-links account.2. Master later closes trade. Expected:Follower position handled per policy chosen at unsubscribe (auto-closed immediately or unlinked for manual management).

scenario: Two subscription requests sent simultaneously Pre: User double-clicks 'Subscribe' button or fires duplicate API calls.
steps: Steps:1. Two POST /subscribe requests arrive at server within 1ms. Expected:Database unique constraint on (master_id, follower_id) enforces exactly one active subscription; second request returns 409 Conflict.

scenario: Two unsubscribe requests sent simultaneously Pre: Duplicate unsubscribe requests sent.
steps: Steps:1. Fire concurrent DELETE /subscribe. Expected:First request executes; second returns idempotent success or 200 OK with status 'Already Unsubscribed'.

scenario: Subscription setting changed while trade is being copied Pre: Follower edits multiplier (from 1x to 2x) while order is in flight.
steps: Steps:1. Order routed.2. Follower submits settings update. Expected:Order execution uses settings snapshot captured at order creation; subsequent trades use updated 2x multiplier.

scenario: Master disabled while followers receive orders Pre: Admin suspends master account while master order is fanning out.
steps: Steps:1. Admin issues Master Deactivate.2. Master trade fan-out in progress. Expected:Pending unfan-out signals cancelled immediately; no further trades executed across follower base.

scenario: One master places BUY with 10 active followers Pre: 10 active followers subscribed with diverse lot sizes.
steps: Steps:1. Master executes BUY EURUSD. Expected:All 10 followers receive correct order within latency SLA (< 200ms); all 10 positions tracked.

scenario: One master places BUY with 100 followers Pre: 100 active followers connected across multiple worker nodes.
steps: Steps:1. Master executes Market Order. Expected:Distributed fan-out queue distributes work to parallel workers; all 100 orders sent without queue saturation or dropped messages.

scenario: One follower rejects while others execute Pre: Follower #5 has insufficient margin; followers #1-4 and #6-10 have normal margin.
steps: Steps:1. Master sends trade to 10 followers. Expected:Follower #5 fails gracefully and logs error; followers #1-4 and #6-10 fill successfully without interruption.

scenario: One follower disconnects while others remain online Pre: Follower #3 network socket drops.
steps: Steps:1. Master fires trade. Expected:Only Follower #3 enters retry/recovery queue; remaining 9 followers execute in real time.

scenario: 50 followers subscribe simultaneously Pre: Master launches popular strategy; 50 users click subscribe at same second.
steps: Steps:1. Ingest 50 subscription requests concurrently. Expected:DB handles concurrency with row-level locks or connection pooling; all 50 subscribed cleanly without deadlocks.

scenario: 50 followers unsubscribe simultaneously Pre: 50 users unsubscribe during high volatility.
steps: Steps:1. Fire 50 concurrent unsubscribe calls. Expected:All 50 unsubscribed successfully; fan-out channel updated; zero dangling subscriptions.

scenario: Multiple masters trade same symbol for one follower Pre: Follower subscribes to Master A and Master B; both trade EURUSD.
steps: Steps:1. Master A opens BUY EURUSD.2. Master B opens BUY EURUSD. Expected:Follower opens two separate positions tagged with respective master IDs; position management remains completely segregated.

scenario: Two masters place opposite orders for same follower Pre: Follower copies Master A and B; Master A buys EURUSD, Master B sells EURUSD.
steps: Steps:1. Master A: BUY EURUSD.2. Master B: SELL EURUSD. Expected:Hedging account: opens both Long and Short positions; Netting account: positions net off cleanly per broker account specification.

scenario: Two masters close positions simultaneously Pre: Follower holds positions from Master A and Master B.
steps: Steps:1. Both masters close trades at same instant. Expected:Each close signal resolves against its specific master-linked ticket; neither cross-closes the other master's position.

scenario: One follower manually closes while master closes Pre: Follower clicks Close on broker app at same instant master closes trade on master terminal.
steps: Steps:1. Follower manual close order and Master automated close order arrive at broker simultaneously. Expected:Broker executes one close; second close receives 'Position already closed' and handles it idempotently without creating a reverse open position.

scenario: Follower disconnects during master BUY Pre: Follower broker connection drops while order is being sent.
steps: Steps:1. Order dispatch fails due to socket error.2. Reconnect trigger. Expected:Engine checks if order was accepted before socket drop; reconciles state cleanly upon reconnect without placing redundant trade.

scenario: Master disconnects immediately after submitting order Pre: Master submits order, network drops before receiving broker acknowledgement.
steps: Steps:1. Master submits order.2. Connection dies.3. Broker actually fills order. Expected:Broker sends fill event via secondary webhook or upon reconnect; copy engine detects confirmed broker fill and copies to followers.

scenario: Network reconnects while order acknowledgement is pending Pre: Follower order sent; network blips before ACK.
steps: Steps:1. Socket reconnects.2. Retry mechanism activates. Expected:Retry uses existing Client Order ID (ClOrdID); broker recognizes idempotent order and returns existing fill without creating second position.

scenario: Broker response delayed while master closes Pre: Follower broker takes 5 seconds to reply; master closes trade in 2 seconds.
steps: Steps:1. Master opens trade.2. Master closes trade.3. Follower open ACK arrives late. Expected:Engine notices Master Close event is already pending for this ticket; immediately fires Follower Close.

scenario: Broker sends duplicate fill event Pre: Broker message broker resends identical execution report.
steps: Steps:1. Receive ExecutionReport (TradeID=9988).2. Receive ExecutionReport (TradeID=9988) 1 second later. Expected:Idempotency filter detects TradeID duplicate; ignores second event; position quantity unchanged.

scenario: Broker sends out-of-order execution events Pre: Network routes 'Order Filled' event before 'Order Acknowledged' event.
steps: Steps:1. Worker receives 'FILLED'.2. Worker receives 'NEW/ACK' 10ms later. Expected:State machine transitions directly to FILLED; late ACK does not downgrade state back to NEW.

scenario: WebSocket reconnects during rapid trading Pre: WebSocket connection breaks during high-volatility session.
steps: Steps:1. WS drops.2. WS reconnects.3. Reconnection resubscribes to missed sequence numbers. Expected:Engine requests event backfill by sequence ID; missed events processed in exact order without duplicates.

scenario: API request times out but broker executes order Pre: HTTP POST to broker returns 504 Gateway Timeout, but broker processed trade.
steps: Steps:1. Timeout caught.2. Reconciliation worker queries broker order status by ClOrdID. Expected:Order found as FILLED; follower record updated to FILLED; no redundant order dispatched.

scenario: Master and follower brokers have different execution speeds Pre: Master fills in 10ms; Follower broker executes in 400ms.
steps: Steps:1. Master fires 3 scalps in quick succession. Expected:Queue manager throttles and pipelines follower orders ensuring each order ticket matches exact master trade sequence.

scenario: Two workers process same copy event concurrently Pre: Distributed consumer group assigns message to two workers due to partition rebalance.
steps: Steps:1. Worker 1 and Worker 2 both attempt to process copy signal for Follower X. Expected:Distributed lock (Redis Redlock / DB row lock) ensures only one worker acquires execution rights; second worker aborts.

scenario: Backend service restarts during order processing Pre: Docker container / Kubernetes pod killed during active trade fan-out.
steps: Steps:1. Kill pod during order execution.2. New pod starts up. Expected:New pod recovers unacknowledged messages from Kafka/RabbitMQ; verifies broker order state; completes remaining fan-out safely.

scenario: Message queue replays events after recovery Pre: Kafka offset reset or replay of past 1 hour events.
steps: Steps:1. Replay 500 historic trade events. Expected:Idempotency filter identifies all replayed events as already processed; zero duplicate orders submitted to broker.

scenario: Two trades arrive when only one position slot remains Pre: Max Positions = 5; Follower currently holds 4 open positions.
steps: Steps:1. Master sends 2 trade signals simultaneously. Expected:Atomic counter check increments slot count; 1st trade opens (5/5); 2nd trade rejected; limit never exceeded.

scenario: Two trades arrive near maximum exposure limit Pre: Max exposure = $10,000; Current exposure = $8,000; Each new trade requires $1,500 exposure.
steps: Steps:1. Two trades arrive simultaneously. Expected:Atomic balance check approves 1st trade ($9,500 total); rejects 2nd trade ($11,000 > $10,000 limit).

scenario: Daily loss threshold reached while order is being copied Pre: Closed loss is $490; Max Daily Loss is $500.
steps: Steps:1. A running trade closes with -$20 loss (breaching $500).2. Master submits new trade concurrently. Expected:Daily loss trigger sets account risk state to FROZEN; new incoming trade rejected immediately.

scenario: Equity changes while follower lot is calculated Pre: Follower using Equity Proportional sizing; market volatility shifts equity during calculation.
steps: Steps:1. Sizing calculation fetches equity snapshot.2. Position opens. Expected:Calculation uses consistent immutable equity snapshot; no division by zero or NaN values.

scenario: Follower changes multiplier while order is processing Pre: Follower updates multiplier in UI while an order is queued for placement.
steps: Steps:1. Order queued with snapshot config (1x).2. Follower changes setting to 2x. Expected:Queued order completes with original 1x snapshot; next incoming order adopts 2x.

scenario: SL and TP triggered during volatile market movement Pre: Flash crash moves price violently through both SL and TP price levels within 100ms.
steps: Steps:1. Broker triggers SL order. Expected:Position closed once; associated TP order cancelled automatically; no double execution or reversal.

scenario: Master closes and reopens same symbol immediately Pre: Master closes BUY EURUSD and opens SELL EURUSD in single script execution.
steps: Steps:1. Close BUY order processed.2. Open SELL order processed. Expected:Follower closes BUY position cleanly, then opens SELL position; tickets properly mapped; zero state confusion.

scenario: Follower manually modifies SL while master modifies SL Pre: Follower changes SL to 1.0800 on terminal; Master changes SL to 1.0820 simultaneously.
steps: Steps:1. Both SL modification requests sent to broker. Expected:System resolves conflict according to precedence policy (Master precedence or Follower Lockout policy); logs conflict event.

scenario: Follower manually opens same-symbol trade while copying Pre: Follower manually opens EURUSD trade while copying EURUSD from Master.
steps: Steps:1. Follower manual order fills.2. Master closes copied trade. Expected:Engine only closes the ticket associated with master copy trading; follower manual trade remains untouched.

scenario: Margin consumed by another trade during copy execution Pre: Two strategies trade simultaneously; combined margin exceeds balance.
steps: Steps:1. Order A consumes free margin.2. Order B attempts to execute. Expected:Pre-execution check at broker fails or rejects Order B safely without negative balance or margin call.

scenario: Risk limit updated while multiple trades arrive Pre: Follower lowers Max Daily Loss while 3 trades arrive.
steps: Steps:1. Risk update transaction commits.2. Incoming trades evaluated. Expected:Evaluated against latest committed risk configuration; threshold breach blocks trades immediately.

scenario: Master order partially fills while cancellation is requested Pre: Master places 10 lots; 4 lots fill immediately, 6 lots remain pending; master hits cancel.
steps: Steps:1. Partial fill event arrives.2. Cancel confirmation arrives. Expected:Follower copies proportional quantity of the filled 4 lots; remaining quantity cancelled cleanly.

scenario: Master receives multiple partial fills out of order Pre: Broker fills 1 lot, 2 lots, 2 lots (total 5 lots) out of sequence.
steps: Steps:1. Ingest partial fill #2, then #1, then #3. Expected:Engine tracks cumulative filled quantity; total follower lots match final cumulative 5 lots exactly.

scenario: Follower receives partial fill while master fully closes Pre: Follower broker partially fills 0.5 lot of 1.0 lot order; master closes position immediately.
steps: Steps:1. Partial fill ACK received for follower.2. Master close signal received. Expected:Engine closes the 0.5 lot follower position and cancels the remaining unfilled 0.5 lot; no orphan exposure.

scenario: Master SL hits while follower SL modification is pending Pre: Follower engine dispatched SL modification to broker; master SL hits on exchange.
steps: Steps:1. Follower SL modify in flight.2. Master Close / SL Trigger event arrives. Expected:Engine issues immediate market close; cancels or ignores pending modify ACK; position closes cleanly.

scenario: Follower liquidated while master position remains open Pre: Follower suffers account stop-out / liquidation due to unrelated trades or high leverage.
steps: Steps:1. Broker triggers liquidation of follower position.2. Master continues holding trade. Expected:Follower position marked as 'Liquidated / Closed by Broker'; copy engine does not re-open trade; master unaffected.

scenario: Two master events have identical timestamps Pre: Two distinct master trades executed at identical millisecond.
steps: Steps:1. Ingest two trades with same timestamp. Expected:System uses monotonic sequence numbers / UUIDs to order and copy both trades deterministically.

scenario: Older subscription update arrives after newer update Pre: Network reordering causes update #1 (v1) to arrive after update #2 (v2).
steps: Steps:1. Apply v2 update.2. Delayed v1 arrives. Expected:Optimistic concurrency check rejects v1 as stale; latest v2 state remains active.

scenario: Risk service and execution service process same trade concurrently Pre: Microservices communicate via event bus.
steps: Steps:1. Trade signal sent to Risk and Execution services in parallel. Expected:Execution service strictly awaits Risk Service cryptographic signature / approval token before placing order.

scenario: Master closes position while follower broker is in maintenance Pre: Follower broker offline for scheduled maintenance (returns 503 / connection refused).
steps: Steps:1. Master closes trade.2. Follower close fails with broker maintenance code. Expected:Engine queues close order in high-priority retry buffer; dispatches immediately upon broker reconnection; alerts user.

scenario: Symbol mapping changes during active copied position Pre: Admin edits symbol mapping from XAUUSD to GOLD while follower holds open position.
steps: Steps:1. Mapping changed.2. Master closes XAUUSD. Expected:Position tracking maintains original mapped symbol ticket; follower position closes correctly on GOLD.

scenario: Master account switches between hedging and netting configurations Pre: Master switches account mode mid-session.
steps: Steps:1. Switch mode.2. Master opens opposite trade. Expected:Engine handles position transitions without corrupting open follower tickets; preserves portfolio integrity.

scenario: Two identical API retries reach separate backend instances Pre: Follower client retries subscribe call; load balancer routes request 1 to Node A, request 2 to Node B.
steps: Steps:1. Node A and Node B process request at same time. Expected:Distributed lock ensures only one node creates subscription; other node returns success with existing record.

scenario: Follower changes broker while a copy order is in flight Pre: Follower initiates broker account change while order is routing.
steps: Steps:1. Order in-flight to Broker 1.2. Follower submits switch to Broker 2. Expected:Broker change blocked or queued until in-flight order reaches final state (FILLED/REJECTED); zero cross-broker leakage.

scenario: Copy service recovers while broker sends delayed fill Pre: Service rebooted; broker sends fill report for an order sent before reboot.
steps: Steps:1. Service restarts.2. Late fill report arrives. Expected:Reconciliation matches fill with pre-reboot pending order; updates position state; no duplicate orders created.

scenario: Performance fee calculation runs while trade closes Pre: Fee settlement cron job triggers at 00:00:00 UTC while large trade is closing at 00:00:00 UTC.
steps: Steps:1. Run settlement cron.2. Close trade concurrently. Expected:Fee calculation uses transaction snapshot; trade either fully settles in current cycle or rolls to next cycle cleanly.

scenario: Two settlement workers calculate same performance fee Pre: Cron schedule triggers duplicated batch jobs on two cluster workers.
steps: Steps:1. Worker 1 and Worker 2 calculate fee for Master M and Follower F. Expected:Unique constraint on (billing_cycle, master_id, follower_id) prevents double deduction; fee processed once.

scenario: Master removes follower while follower closes position Pre: Master kicks follower out of strategy while follower manually closes copied position.
steps: Steps:1. Master disconnects follower.2. Follower manual close order executes. Expected:Follower manual close succeeds; relationship severed; no locking deadlocks.

scenario: Follower deposits or withdraws during proportional lot calculation Pre: Follower withdraws $5,000 at exact instant master executes trade.
steps: Steps:1. Balance withdrawal processed.2. Sizing engine executes. Expected:Engine uses verified atomic post-withdrawal balance; order sized safely without margin call risk.

scenario: Master reverses position while follower close is delayed Pre: Master flips Long to Short; follower Long close is delayed by broker.
steps: Steps:1. Master closes Long and opens Short.2. Follower Long close delayed. Expected:Engine queues follower Short open until follower Long close is confirmed; prevents unintended double exposure.

scenario: Stop-copy and close-all requests execute simultaneously Pre: Follower hits 'Stop Copying' and 'Close All Positions' concurrently.
steps: Steps:1. Execute both commands in parallel. Expected:System coalesces requests into single atomic teardown: subscription severed, all positions closed once, zero redundant orders.

scenario: Subscribe without valid broker connection Pre: Follower account has no linked broker credentials.
steps: Steps:1. Attempt to subscribe to master strategy. Expected:Request blocked with error: 'Valid broker account connection required before copying'.

scenario: Subscribe using unauthorized account Pre: Follower attempts to link broker account belonging to another user.
steps: Steps:1. Submit broker account ID of User B from User A account. Expected:Broker OAuth/API verification fails; request rejected with 403 Forbidden; security audit alert generated.

scenario: Invalid master account ID Pre: Malicious or malformed API request.
steps: Steps:1. POST /api/copy/subscribe with master_id='invalid_uuid_9999'. Expected:Returns 404 Not Found with message 'Master trader strategy does not exist'.

scenario: Unsupported follower symbol Pre: Master trades exotic pair (e.g., USDRUB) not offered by follower's broker.
steps: Steps:1. Master executes BUY USDRUB. Expected:Follower engine recognizes symbol not supported; trade skipped; clear notification sent: 'Symbol not supported by your broker'.

scenario: Follower lot below broker minimum Pre: Calculated follower lot is 0.003; broker minimum lot is 0.01.
steps: Steps:1. Sizing formula computes lot < min_lot. Expected:Order either adjusted to 0.01 (if round-up allowed) or skipped safely per configured policy; no invalid broker API error.

scenario: Follower lot above broker maximum Pre: Calculated follower lot is 150.0; broker max lot per ticket is 100.0.
steps: Steps:1. Master places large order. Expected:Engine splits order into 100.0 + 50.0 or caps at 100.0 per account policy; executes smoothly without broker rejection.

scenario: Broker rejects invalid SL/TP Pre: Master SL is too close to market price (violates broker Freeze Level / Stop Level).
steps: Steps:1. Master submits trade with SL within 1 pip of market. Expected:Follower broker rejection handled gracefully; position opened without SL or SL adjusted to valid broker distance; alert raised.

scenario: Master account has no available margin Pre: Master account margin level < 100%.
steps: Steps:1. Master attempts to open trade; broker rejects master order. Expected:No trade event dispatched to followers; followers completely unaffected.

scenario: Follower account is read-only or disabled Pre: Follower broker password set to Investor (read-only) or account suspended.
steps: Steps:1. Master trades. Expected:Broker returns 'Trade Disabled'; engine automatically pauses follower subscription and sends notification to update credentials.

scenario: Master attempts to copy own account Pre: Master trader attempts to subscribe to their own strategy using the same master account.
steps: Steps:1. Master submits subscription to self. Expected:Engine validation rejects request: 'Self-copying is not permitted'.

scenario: Circular master-follower relationship Pre: Account A is master for Account B.
steps: Steps:1. Account B attempts to register as master and Account A attempts to subscribe to Account B. Expected:Graph cycle detection algorithm detects circular loop (A -> B -> A) and blocks subscription.

scenario: Copy trading API called without authorization token Pre: Unauthenticated client.
steps: Steps:1. Send curl request to copy endpoints without JWT header. Expected:Request rejected immediately with 401 Unauthorized.

scenario: Follower attempts to view another follower's data Pre: Follower A authenticated with valid JWT.
steps: Steps:1. GET /api/follower/positions?follower_id={Follower_B_UUID}. Expected:Object-level authorization check blocks request; returns 403 Forbidden; no data leak.

scenario: Invalid risk configuration saved Pre: Follower inputs negative max drawdown (-20%) or text string in lot size.
steps: Steps:1. Submit invalid payload. Expected:Schema validation returns 422 Unprocessable Entity; previous valid settings retained unchanged.

scenario: Copy order fails repeatedly Pre: Follower broker API returns continuous 500 server errors.
steps: Steps:1. Engine attempts retry 1, 2, 3 with exponential backoff. Expected:Retry terminates at max attempts (e.g. 3); order marked 'FAILED'; follower subscription auto-paused to protect account; alert sent.

scenario: Master and follower execute at different prices (Slippage P&L) Pre: Master fills BUY EURUSD at 1.0800; Follower fills at 1.0802 due to latency.
steps: Steps:1. Price moves to 1.0850; both close trades. Expected:Master realized P&L = +50 pips; Follower realized P&L = +48 pips; each account ledger reflects exact execution fill prices.

scenario: Master and follower have different quantities Pre: Master trades 10 lots; Follower trades 0.5 lot.
steps: Steps:1. Trade gains 100 pips ($10,000 for master). Expected:Follower gains exactly $500 (proportional to 0.5 lot); P&L math verified to the cent.

scenario: Follower partially closes trade Pre: Follower holds 1.0 lot; closes 0.4 lot manually or via partial TP.
steps: Steps:1. Execute 0.4 lot close. Expected:Realized P&L booked for 0.4 lot; Unrealized P&L calculated on remaining 0.6 lot; margin released proportionally.

scenario: Commission differs between brokers Pre: Master broker charges $0 commission (spread-only); Follower broker charges $7/lot ECN commission.
steps: Steps:1. Trade executed and closed. Expected:Follower net P&L correctly deducts $7/lot commission; reports accurately separate Gross P&L, Commission, and Net P&L.

scenario: Swap or overnight financing charged Pre: Position held across Wednesday 22:00 UTC rollover (triple swap).
steps: Steps:1. Rollover occurs. Expected:Broker swap charges applied to follower position; reflected in follower trade details and net return calculations.

scenario: High-Water Mark (HWM) performance fee calculation Pre: Master charges 20% perf fee; Billing cycle ends. Follower initial equity = $10,000; ends at $12,000 (Profit = $2,000).
steps: Steps:1. Billing job runs. Expected:Performance fee of $400 (20% of $2,000) calculated; deducted from follower and credited to master; new HWM set to $11,600.

scenario: Same closed trade event replayed in reporting engine Pre: Reporting sync cron restarts and ingests past closed trades.
steps: Steps:1. Ingest already-settled trade ID #5544. Expected:Reporting database deduplicates trade ID; historical P&L and follower total balance remain unchanged.

scenario: Master trade profitable, follower trade losing due to slippage Pre: Master scalps 1 pip profit; Follower loses 2 pips due to spread widening.
steps: Steps:1. Both trades close. Expected:System records Master: +$10, Follower: -$20; reports accurately display real independent financial outcomes; no fee deducted from follower.

scenario: Follower trade rejected by broker Pre: Follower order rejected at placement time.
steps: Steps:1. Master trade closes in profit. Expected:Follower records zero trades; zero realized/unrealized P&L; zero phantom fees.

scenario: Dashboard refresh during execution Pre: Follower looking at web dashboard while 5 positions are opening/closing.
steps: Steps:1. WebSocket pushes live updates; user manually refreshes page. Expected:Balance, equity, margin level, and floating P&L match broker account state down to the second.

scenario: Master trades during follower closed market session (Weekend / Holiday) Pre: Master trades crypto 24/7 or offshore CFD during public holiday when follower broker exchange is closed.
steps: Steps:1. Master executes BUY order.2. Engine checks follower symbol trading schedule.3. Session validator evaluates market status. Expected:Order rejected gracefully for follower; master trade remains intact; clear audit log stating 'Market Closed for Follower Account'; no infinite retry loop.

scenario: Master executes during high-impact news event with massive spread widening Pre: Non-Farm Payroll (NFP) release causes EURUSD spread to widen from 0.8 pips to 12.0 pips.
steps: Steps:1. Master fills BUY EURUSD at 1.0850.2. Follower broker spread is 12 pips.3. Pre-trade spread check evaluates follower spread against Max Spread limit (e.g. 5 pips). Expected:Follower spread filter blocks execution; logs 'Skipped: Spread widened beyond maximum tolerance (12.0 > 5.0 pips)'; follower protected from severe slippage.

scenario: Trading halt or circuit breaker triggered on symbol at follower broker Pre: Stock/Index halts (Limit Up / Limit Down - LULD) on Follower venue, while Master fills on international venue.
steps: Steps:1. Master executes trade.2. Follower broker returns exchange halt status code (e.g. HALTED). Expected:Follower routing recognizes halt; moves order to pending-reconciliation queue; does not throw unhandled runtime exceptions; notifies follower.

scenario: Weekend price gap blows past both Master and Follower Stop Loss Pre: Positions held over weekend; geopolitical event causes 80-pip gap over weekend, blowing through SL at open.
steps: Steps:1. Market opens on Sunday 22:00 UTC.2. Broker triggers Stop Loss execution at first available market tick. Expected:Follower position closed at first available market tick; negative equity protection verifies account balance does not breach policy; position ledger updated accurately.

scenario: Master trades illiquid instrument consuming multiple order book levels Pre: Master trades illiquid exotic pair or small-cap CFD with thin order book.
steps: Steps:1. Master places large order.2. 50 followers attempt to execute concurrently. Expected:Pre-trade liquidity check or staged execution prevents followers from eating the entire book and triggering massive market impact; slippage thresholds enforced.

scenario: Master places aggressive iceberg order Pre: Master uses algorithmic hidden/iceberg order.
steps: Steps:1. Master iceberg triggers repeated visible fills. Expected:Follower engine maps incremental visible fills to follower orders without flooding follower broker with duplicate limit tickets.

scenario: Daylight Saving Time (DST) shift creates session mismatch Pre: US switches to DST one week before Europe/UK; trading session hours shift by 1 hour.
steps: Steps:1. Master trades US market open.2. Follower broker operates on European time schedule. Expected:Engine time synchronizer validates UTC timestamps; handles DST offset smoothly without rejecting orders due to false 'Market Closed' flags.

scenario: Symbol rollover / expiry date on futures-based CFDs (e.g., USOIL / WTI) Pre: Crude oil contract reaches monthly expiry.
steps: Steps:1. Master rolls position to next front month contract.2. Follower holds expiring contract. Expected:Engine detects contract rollover; either executes rollover simultaneously on follower or safely closes expired contract with appropriate rollover notification.

scenario: Broker quote freeze / stale price feed during sudden volatility Pre: Follower broker price feed freezes for 4 seconds during market shock.
steps: Steps:1. Master executes at current real price.2. Follower engine receives stale quote from follower broker feed. Expected:Stale quote detection identifies quote timestamp > 2000ms old; delays execution until fresh quote received or rejects per staleness policy.

scenario: Negative pricing handling (e.g., negative oil / commodity price event) Pre: Commodity price drops to zero or below zero.
steps: Steps:1. Master trades at or near zero.2. System computes margin and P&L. Expected:Math and validation models do not fail with ZeroDivisionError or negative price assertion crashes; positions tracked safely.

scenario: Master uses Hedging, follower account in US FIFO / No-Hedging jurisdiction Pre: Follower account governed by US NFA Rule 2-43(b) (FIFO and No-Hedging); Master account allows hedging.
steps: Steps:1. Follower holds Long EURUSD.2. Master opens Short EURUSD. Expected:Engine FIFO adapter either closes oldest Long position (if configured) or blocks the opposite Short with a clear regulatory explanation: 'Hedging prohibited by NFA Rule 2-43(b)'.

scenario: Master has 1:500 leverage, follower account is restricted to 1:30 (ESMA retail rules) Pre: Master is professional/offshore account (1:500); Follower is EU retail account (1:30).
steps: Steps:1. Master opens 5.0 lots with low required margin.2. Follower sizing engine calculates required margin at 1:30. Expected:Engine computes required margin using 1:30 leverage; downsizes follower lot or rejects if free margin insufficient; never exceeds follower leverage cap.

scenario: Follower KYC expires or enters 'Close-Only' suspension Pre: Follower fails annual KYC refresh or enters restricted status.
steps: Steps:1. Master opens new trade.2. Master closes an existing trade. Expected:New master open trade is blocked for follower; master close trade is allowed through so follower can safely exit existing market risk.

scenario: Restricted country IP access during order replication Pre: Master or Follower logs in from sanctioned / restricted geographic jurisdiction.
steps: Steps:1. Geo-IP filter detects restricted location.2. Action attempted. Expected:Compliance firewall blocks new trade copying; notifies account compliance team; records immutable audit log.

scenario: Suitability and risk-profile questionnaire gating Pre: Regulatory requirement (MiFID II) requires suitability test for high-risk CFD copy trading.
steps: Steps:1. User with conservative risk profile attempts to copy high-risk crypto/scalp master. Expected:System presents suitability mismatch warning; requires explicit risk acknowledgment before allowing subscription.

scenario: Maximum capital allocation cap per follower (Retail Investor Protection) Pre: Regulatory cap restricts retail followers from allocating > 20% of net assets to a single master strategy.
steps: Steps:1. Follower attempts to allocate $50,000 when declared liquid net worth is $100,000 (50%). Expected:System blocks allocation exceeding 20% cap; displays regulatory limit prompt.

scenario: Master trader regulatory licensing validation Pre: Jurisdiction requires master traders charging management fees to hold RIA or portfolio management license.
steps: Steps:1. Unlicensed master sets 30% performance fee.2. Compliance engine validates master credentials. Expected:Fee-charging capability locked until compliance verification uploaded and approved.

scenario: Audit log immutability and regulatory reporting export Pre: Regulator requests audit trail of all copy-trade executions for Master X and 500 followers for date Y.
steps: Steps:1. Compliance officer exports Regulatory Copy Audit Report. Expected:Report outputs complete time-stamped log with microsecond precision, broker ClOrdIDs, fill prices, slippage, and fee breakdowns in tamper-evident format.

scenario: Primary copy database fails over to replica during active trade wave Pre: Master executes trade to 500 followers; PostgreSQL primary node crashes at 50% execution.
steps: Steps:1. Database failover triggers; replica promoted to primary.2. In-flight transaction state inspected. Expected:Connection pooler reconnects; in-flight executions resume or rollback cleanly; idempotency keys prevent duplicate orders upon replica connection.

scenario: Message queue latency spikes (Stale Trade Protection) Pre: Kafka broker latency spikes, causing trade signal to reach worker 8 seconds after master executed.
steps: Steps:1. Worker receives signal with master_timestamp = T - 8s.2. Stale signal policy threshold = 3s. Expected:Stale Trade Protection drops signal; logs 'Dropped: Signal age 8000ms exceeded 3000ms threshold'; prevents off-market follower fills.

scenario: Signal processing failure routes message to Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) Pre: Corrupted payload or unrecoverable broker format error occurs.
steps: Steps:1. Worker retries message 3 times; all fail. Expected:Message routed to DLQ; PagerDuty/Slack alert fires for SRE; worker continues processing subsequent healthy messages without stalling queue.

scenario: Daily End-of-Day (EOD) automated reconciliation batch job Pre: Day trades conclude; 23:59:00 UTC reconciliation cron executes.
steps: Steps:1. Script queries copy trading DB open positions.2. Script queries actual broker clearing account open positions.3. Compare tickets, lots, symbols. Expected:Zero discrepancies found; if discrepancy exists, automated alert created and flagged for manual operations review before morning session.

scenario: High-frequency trade burst with rate limiting (Anti-Throttling) Pre: Master robot executes 30 trades in 2 seconds; broker API limit is 10 requests/sec.
steps: Steps:1. Ingest burst.2. Rate limiter queues and paces outbound requests to broker. Expected:Outbound requests metered to stay below 10 req/s; zero 429 Too Many Requests errors received from broker.

scenario: Redis Cache eviction / memory saturation under heavy fan-out Pre: Redis instance reaches maxmemory limit during peak trading wave.
steps: Steps:1. Redis memory reaches threshold.2. Cache eviction policy activates. Expected:Critical session and subscription locks are protected with volatile-lru/noeviction; system degrades gracefully without dropping live subscriptions.

scenario: Multi-region latency optimization and routing Pre: Master in London (LD4); Followers across Frankfurt (FR2), New York (NY4), and Tokyo (TY3).
steps: Steps:1. Signal emitted from London node.2. Distributed edge workers route orders. Expected:Orders routed via regional edge workers closest to respective follower brokers, achieving lowest possible cross-venue execution latency.

scenario: Zero-downtime rolling deployment of copy engine microservice Pre: Engine version 2.1 deployed to Kubernetes cluster while 1,000 active followers are copying.
steps: Steps:1. Rolling update replaces pods one by one. Expected:Active WebSocket connections drain smoothly; new pods take over signal routing without missed or duplicated copy trades.

scenario: Network partition between Copy Engine and Broker FIX / WebSocket Gateway Pre: Gateway connection severed for 15 seconds.
steps: Steps:1. Heartbeat fails.2. Automatic FIX sequence reset and resend request initiated upon reconnection. Expected:Gateway resends unacknowledged FIX messages; sequence numbers sync cleanly; zero duplicate order fills.

scenario: Cold start recovery after total datacenter power loss Pre: All servers abruptly lose power; restart in disaster recovery environment.
steps: Steps:1. Services boot up.2. State restoration worker queries brokers for actual live open positions. Expected:System reconstructs live portfolio state directly from verified broker ledgers before reopening signal processing.

scenario: Master hides floating unrealized drawdown to fake 100% Win Rate Pre: Master holds 10 losing positions (-$5,000 unrealized loss) while closing only winning trades.
steps: Steps:1. Master profile metrics generated for public leaderboard. Expected:Leaderboard calculates ROI based on **Equity (Time-Weighted Return)** rather than closed balance; Maximum Drawdown displays true floating peak-to-trough drop.

scenario: Follower front-running prevention (Latency Arbitrage Protection) Pre: Follower attempts to intercept Master's trade signal via WebSocket to trade on a faster secondary venue before copy execution.
steps: Steps:1. Master order executed.2. Signal broadcast timing evaluated. Expected:Public trade stream published only AFTER follower orders are dispatched to brokers; execution parameters protected against front-running.

scenario: High-Water Mark (HWM) proportional adjustment on follower withdrawal Pre: Follower deposited $10,000; earned $2,000 profit (Equity = $12,000; HWM = $12,000); Follower withdraws $6,000 (50%).
steps: Steps:1. Withdrawal processed.2. Engine recalculates HWM. Expected:HWM is proportionally reduced by 50% from $12,000 to $6,000; ensures follower is not unfairly over-billed or exempt from valid fees in subsequent cycles.

scenario: Master micro-lot churning detection (Volume / Rebate gaming) Pre: Master opens and closes 500 micro-trades per day lasting 2 seconds to generate affiliate commissions.
steps: Steps:1. Churning detection engine analyzes trade frequency and duration. Expected:Heuristics detect abnormal churn; flags master strategy for compliance review; warns followers of excessive turnover.

scenario: Sudden strategy shift detection (Style Drift Warning) Pre: Master registered as 'Low Risk Swing Forex Trader'; suddenly opens 50x leverage meme crypto trades.
steps: Steps:1. Style drift monitor evaluates asset class and position leverage. Expected:Risk engine triggers 'Style Drift Warning' on master profile; notifies subscribed followers of abrupt risk profile change.

scenario: Follower reverse-engineering master algorithmic strategy Pre: Follower scrapes tick-by-tick master data via API to steal IP of proprietary quant strategy.
steps: Steps:1. Follower makes 10,000 API calls per minute to scrape master order book. Expected:Rate limiter enforces API query limits; obfuscates sub-second microsecond metadata to protect master intellectual property.

scenario: Master account bankruptcy / negative equity protection Pre: Black swan event causes master account to fall into negative balance.
steps: Steps:1. Master account balance drops below zero. Expected:Master account immediately suspended; copy signal fan-out halted; followers' risk management prevents follower accounts from mirroring negative balance.

scenario: Master fake review and rating manipulation Pre: Master creates burner accounts to post 5-star ratings and fake testimonials.
steps: Steps:1. System evaluates reviewer eligibility. Expected:Only verified followers with active copy history > 14 days and funded accounts are permitted to review/rate master strategies.

scenario: Admin triggers Global Emergency Kill-Switch Pre: Catastrophic platform-wide anomaly or severe market crash detected.
steps: Steps:1. Admin clicks 'GLOBAL EMERGENCY STOP' in Back-Office Portal.2. Confirms 2FA / dual authorization. Expected:Signal ingestion instantly halted across all masters; no new orders dispatched; active positions enter safe-mode; banner displayed on all user interfaces.

scenario: Admin halts individual rogue or compromised Master Trader Pre: Master account compromised by hacker sending erratic market orders.
steps: Steps:1. Admin navigates to Master Control.2. Clicks 'Freeze Master Strategy'. Expected:Master strategy isolated immediately; fan-out severed; prompt offers bulk-close of all open copied positions across followers.

scenario: Follower Panic Button: 'Emergency Close All and Unsubscribe' Pre: Follower sees rapid losses during high volatility and wants immediate exit.
steps: Steps:1. Follower clicks 'Emergency Close All & Unsubscribe' in mobile app. Expected:Engine severes subscription and dispatches market close orders for all open copied trades concurrently in a single atomic transaction.

scenario: Customer Support Trade Dispute & Resolution Tool Pre: Follower reports trade mismatch / unexpected slippage loss on EURUSD.
steps: Steps:1. Support agent opens Dispute Resolution Console.2. Enters Follower Ticket ID. Expected:Console displays end-to-end trace: Master execution timestamp, network latency, queue transit time, follower broker submission, fill report, and slippage delta.

scenario: Manual compensation / adjustment credit workflow Pre: Technical glitch causes follower order failure; management approves $150 credit.
steps: Steps:1. Support supervisor initiates adjustment credit in Back-Office. Expected:Credit deposited into follower account ledger with audit tag 'SYSTEM_OUTAGE_COMPENSATION'; balance updated; notification emailed.

scenario: Master profit share payout and tax withholding reporting Pre: Monthly performance fee payout to master trader.
steps: Steps:1. Payout batch processes accrued performance fees. Expected:Fees transferred to master wallet; tax withholding (if applicable) calculated and reported; downloadable invoice generated.

scenario: Automated alert for high slippage deviation (> 5 pips) Pre: Follower broker execution price deviates > 5 pips from master price.
steps: Steps:1. Follower order fills.2. Post-trade analysis detects slippage anomaly. Expected:Automated alert sent to Trading Desk / SRE; trade tagged as 'HIGH_SLIPPAGE_ALERT' for broker SLA review.

scenario: Compliance data retention and immutable audit archive (7 Years) Pre: Regulatory archiving policy for financial transactions.
steps: Steps:1. Run automated archival pipeline for closed trades older than 90 days. Expected:Data compressed and stored in WORM (Write Once, Read Many) cloud storage (e.g. AWS S3 Glacier with Object Lock); verifiable checksums generated.
